scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. I haven't heard anything back yet.
dialogue.agent: I can help you with that. I see your loan application, LOAN-00206. The action taken on your application was that the loan was originated.

dialogue.user: Originated? Does that mean it was approved? And if so, what are the terms of the loan? I'm particularly interested in the interest rate and the total costs associated with it. Also, what is the loan term?
dialogue.agent:
Yes, "originated" means your loan was approved.

The interest rate for your loan is 8.740%.
The total loan costs are $241.32.
The loan term is 60 months.

dialogue.user: That interest rate seems quite high. Can you tell me if there are any HOEPA high-cost flags on this loan, or any negative amortization features? I'm also curious if my loan has been sold or transferred to another institution.
dialogue.agent: This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. It also does not have negative amortization features. The purchaser type for this loan is not applicable, meaning it has not been sold.

dialogue.user: <Satisfied> - Thank you for clarifying those details for me. While the interest rate is higher than I hoped, I appreciate you answering all my questions clearly and promptly. I feel like I have a good understanding of my loan now.
